turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So what brings you in here to the ER?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well, I thought I should start by saying I was recently hospitalised for pneumonia. I left five days ago, but as soon as I left that evening, I started coughing again and now I have all the same symptoms. I have a cough, I'm feeling short of breath and I have a feeling like I have a fever.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and before you were discharged the day, can you let me know what you had and what kind of things were you treated with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I was treated with some antibiotics, I don't know exactly which ones. They said I had some sort of bacterial pneumonia.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. But then it got resolved and they sent you home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, that's right.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So are your symptoms similar to when you got admitted?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: They are similar, but I feel like they are also worse now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, worse, OK, so you're having a cough, shortness of breath and fever, and did that all start together? Or did one come before another?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, so the cough came first, then the shortness of breath, and then the fever.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and the cough, how would you describe the cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it's harsh, it's persistent.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Are you producing any sputum?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I guess a little bit, yeah. Yeah, I guess a little bit and it's yellow.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: It's yellow, OK, do you notice any kind of blood in your sputum?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no blood.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so just yellow sputum and how much would you say you're producing an average day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, maybe like, 10 to 15 times in a day I produce enough to fill like the inside of my palm.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And with the fever, did you get a chance to measure, take a temperature at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no, I haven't actually taken my temperature.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, but you've been having chills and are you having any other symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, chills. I've been feeling kind of hot during the day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, OK. And how about the shortness of breath, is that just during activity or you can have that when you're sleeping or resting as well?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: The shortness of breath is more with like activity when I'm walking around.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have all these symptoms been getting worse at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I'd say they're getting worse now. It's like this everyday and it's definitely getting worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you feel dizzy or lightheaded at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you have any muscle aches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, a little bit.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and where on your muscles would you say are aching?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say my lower limbs and just generally all over, but just yeah like the big muscles like my thighs, my shoulders.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you been having any kind of swelling in your limbs at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no swelling.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and any kind of swelling of your neck region or lymph nodes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I noticed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you feel any kind of chest pain with shortness of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and since you've been out of the hospital, have you been in contact with anyone who's sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I went straight home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And any recent travel?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no recent travel.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No headaches.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any kind of fatigue or increased tiredness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I feel fatigued, yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you feel at all that your heart is racing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you have any symptoms like a loss of taste, sense of taste or smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So, OK, any kind of bowel movement issues? Any constipation or diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And any urinary trouble?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you lost any weight recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you been able to sleep throughout the night or does the cough  wake you up or the chills wake you up?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no,  they don't wake me up. I wouldn't say that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Are you having any other symptoms like a sore throat, runny nose, congestion, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and anything in your house like dust or an old carpet or pets? Anything that triggers some of these symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. OK, and in terms of your past medical history, any conditions that you've been diagnosed with like asthma, COPD, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you take any medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I do, I take some multivitamins particularly calcium and vitamin D, and I'm also on Synthroid.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so do you have hyperthyroidism?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, sorry I forgot to mention that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No worries. Then when you went home and you were discharged, did they give you any antibiotics to finish at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah yes, they did. So I only had one days worth left. I was switched from IV antibiotic  to the oral kind and so I'd finish the remaining pills that day, then went home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so you finished the course, OK. Great and do you have any past history when you were admitted, any other hospitalizations or surgeries at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you have any family history of asthma, COPD or any lung conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any other conditions that run in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And currently, where do you live?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I live in a house with my daughter and her husband.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any one of them have similar symptoms or have been sick recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had a COVID test done at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no, no COVID tests have been done. I had one in the hospital before I was admitted, but none today.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you smoke at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I used to smoke. I don't smoke anymore.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and when did you quit?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: About seven years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK congratulations.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And how much would you say you smoked before that, and for how many years?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Before that, I would say it's like gosh, 20 years and then about a pack a day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I drink like a glass of wine a week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any other recreational drugs like marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Yeah, so is there anything else? Any other questions that you have for me today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, what do you think I have?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, so there's definitely multiple things that can be going on. Since you were just recently admitted, maybe you might have another bacterial r espiratory infection, like a pneumonia or it could be viral as well. So the first thing we want to do is for sure get COVID swab done and then we will also get, since you were admitted, as well recently, we want to get an X Ray on you just to see if there's any pneumonia. OK, and so we'll be keeping you here for a bit until everything comes back. We'll get some blood work done for you as well to see if there's any infection in your body. And then yeah, so just sit tight, we'll get all those things done. Is that OK with you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, that's great. Thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You're welcome, yeah. So well will be updating you shortly.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, great, thank you.
